EC1: Previous surgical or catheter ablation [AND] for atrial fibrillation
EC2: Previous cardiac surgery (including CABG) within the past 6 months (180 days)
EC3: Valvular cardiac surgical/percutaneous procedure (i.e., ventriculotomy [OR], atriotomy [OR], and valve [OR] repair [OR] or replacement and presence of a prosthetic valve)
EC6: LA size > 50 mm (parasternal long axis view)
EC9: History of blood clotting [OR] or bleeding abnormalities
EC10: PCI/MI within the past 2 months [OR]  (60 days)
EC11: Documented thromboembolic event (including TIA) within the past 12 months [OR] (365 days)
EC13: Uncontrolled heart failure or NYHA function class III [OR] or IV
EC14: Severe mitral regurgitation (Regurgitant volume= 60 mL/beat [OR] , Regurgitant fraction = 50%  [OR] , and/or Effective regurgitant orifice area = 0.40cm2)
EC15: Awaiting cardiac transplantation [OR] or other cardiac surgery within the next 12 months (365 days)
EC17: Acute illness or active systemic infection or sepsis
EC18: AF secondary [AND] to electrolyte imbalance, thyroid disease [OR], or reversible or non-cardiac cause.
EC20: Significant pulmonary disease, (e.g., restrictive pulmonary disease [OR], constrictive [OR] or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease)  [OR] or any other disease [OR] or malfunction of the lungs or respiratory system [AND] that produces chronic symptoms.
EC21: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD  [OR]; active requiring significant intervention [AND] [NOT] not including OTC medication)
EC22: Significant congenital anomaly or medical problem that in the opinion of the investigator would preclude enrollment in this study.
EC23: Women who are pregnant [AND] (as evidenced by pregnancy test [AND] if pre-menopausal)
EC24: Concurrent enrollment in an investigational study evaluating another device [OR], biologic  [OR], or drug.
EC25: Presence of intracardiac thrombus [OR], myxoma [OR], tumor [OR], interatrial baffle [OR] or patch [OR] or other abnormality [AND] that precludes vascular access [OR], or manipulation of the catheter.
